items.prompt: Prove the derangement recurrence and explain the n=k and k=n-1 boundaries.
items.modelAnswer: Distinguished label chooses one of m-1 successors. A two-cycle leaves D(m-2); removing it from a longer cycle gives D(m-1), bijectively. D(0)=1,D(1)=0. Thus n=k has one identity permutation; k=n-1 is impossible.
